verdict.rationale: Shopify provides extensive official tooling: Shopify CLI for scaffolding apps/themes/storefronts (shopify-docs-3,17,30,42), official Admin and Storefront GraphQL APIs and SDKs (shopify-docs-18,31,32), webhooks, dev stores for testing, and GraphiQL for API exploration (shopify-docs-x2,x3). This clearly covers the SDK and scaffolding-tooling parts of the story. However, the documented app review/distribution path is thin in the evidence pack, and a community report describes an opaque approval process where developer accounts were banned 'for some vague reason' with no clear communication (shopify-comm-7), undercutting confidence in a well-documented review path. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the App Store submission/review criteria and distribution process, plus independent confirmation that the review process is transparent and reliable.
